Alex — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the proposed next steps so we stay aligned. Let me know if I misunderstood anything.

Summary of needs
- Pilot: 2-week pilot to validate throughput for nightly risk-reporting job (avg seq length ~1k tokens).
- Latency target: 99th <= 300ms for sampling use case; batch-friendly for analytics workers.
- Security: data residency in us-east (VPC option) + enterprise logging for audit.
- Cost goal: keep inference unit cost within 30% of current vendor.

1) I will share a short mutual action plan and a draft SOW + standard T&Cs for your procurement/legal to review (attached).
2) Please share the procurement contact and the legal distro to receive redlines.
3) Proposed pilot start window: week of May 24; is that still realistic on your side?
